landmark: Old Bridge Area of the Old City of Mostar
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Bosnia and Herzegovina
Primary request: The Old Bridge Area of Mostar, with recognizable Stari Most arching over the Neretva River.
Subject: A narrow pale-limestone humpback bridge with one graceful high stone arch and no intermediate river piers, modest stone bridge-end towers and the old town's warm stone houses with red-tiled roofs.
Scene/backdrop: Clear green-turquoise Neretva flowing between steep rocky banks below the bridge, leafy riverside trees and layered low hills, blue sky. Believable Mostar Ottoman old-town setting.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, faithful recognizable bridge geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Broad river-level three-quarter view clearly showing the entire single arch, both bridge ends and water beneath; important geometry comfortably inside central 75% width and height, with breathing room.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, peaceful and inviting.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No multi-arch viaduct, suspension bridge, fairy castle, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: one high graceful limestone Stari Most arch without river piers, modest bridge-end towers, turquoise-green Neretva between rocky banks, red-roofed old town, distant minarets and green hills. Main arch is comfortably centered. No multi-arch substitute, readable text, flags, UI or logos. Stylized historic town composition.
